acceptance_criteria.text: A tested exact-path classifier selects metadata guards for explicit eligible workstream records and affected workflow tests with product-input equivalence for workflow-only changes; direct tree comparison uses the same exact SHA whose full prior qualification is trusted, including first pushes behind a newer staging head; product, test, dependency, lock, configuration, unknown, and unproven paths select broad validation. Skipped suites are never reported as newly passed.
The metadata lane validates workstream/hash/scope and runtime narrative guards, including test_current_workstream_narrative_counts_match_runtime_and_yaml_ledgers when metadata is changed.

CI observation allows 243 minutes for bounded prerequisite-plus-gate observation, distinguishes pending expiry, failed tests, and unavailable evidence; it fetches jobs only after terminal status and avoids retry discovery for non-eligible terminal failures.

Master reuses only trusted successful exact-SHA staging gate evidence after synchronized-ref checks, then passes actual master release identity/provenance checks; the promotion helper requires exact staging/master run IDs and explicit schema-2 reuse mode without relabeling unexecuted tests.
The Root-authorized local bootstrap exception allows a complete ready plan under the verified exclusive claim without a plan-only push; clean synchronized integration checks remain mandatory.

Guidance records observed and expected cost implications, focused checks, one coherent publication, compact current handoffs, and all existing authorization, access, paid/provider/quota, data, and evidence safeguards.

Focused workflow regressions and relevant workstream guards pass; Root's delegated acceptance allows ready_for_integration after one coherent checkpoint, while exact pushed-source CI and Root-owned integration, promotion, and deployment remain mandatory.

Every GitHub workflow job has a unique display name regardless of whether it runs or is skipped; master requires only Master Release Provenance, and the verifier still validates all unique successful staging jobs. The schema-2 reader accepts prior compatibility receipts and legacy github_replay receipts.

After a scoped immediate parent, fallback is allowed only when a direct two-tree diff from the exact branch/staging merge-base classifies the entire delta eligible and genuine full CI is verified for that same SHA; an unqualified runtime-bearing parent remains broad.

Staging runs changed-scope followed by one successful authoritative make validate-integration gate; standalone backend/frontend/E2E jobs are skipped and removed from the gate prerequisites. The full Makefile recipe and all phases remain unchanged, while feature branch broad checks remain. New full_staging_single_gate_v1 evidence is exact-source and explicitly records skipped standalone jobs; prior-full and master verification accept that profile plus legacy successful four/five-job full-run evidence, fail closed on scoped/partial/duplicate/wrong-source runs, and receipts distinguish new from legacy profiles.
